responsibility: Implements tracing, dumping, and selftest hookup support for the GIMPLE ranger and GORI subsystems. It provides the range_tracer output mechanics used to annotate range computations with stable trace indices, debug helpers that seed and dump ranger knowledge for functions or CFG paths, RAII dump-file switching, and inclusion of the ranger selftests in checking builds.
same_name_distinction: Implements the tracing/debugging behavior itself: range_tracer output mechanics, dump helpers, dump-file RAII behavior, debug seeding of ranger state, and inclusion of ranger selftests. Unlike gcc/gimple-range-trace.h, it provides the executable tracing and debug-support code rather than just the tracing API declarations.
